MOVE ROUTING: See 18_RICO_KNOWLEDGE_INDEX_QUERY_MAP.txt

PSO ITEM ENDPOINT INDEX
=======================

PURPOSE
Cross-platform item-centric index. Use it to find all known routes for an item, identify exclusivity in the packaged corpus, and compare best routes. Exact rates still inherit the platform-specific authority rules.

SOURCE BASIS
item-endpoint-index.json, derived from the packaged drop datasets.

RETRIEVAL RULE
Treat explicit platform labels, verification/status fields, source labels, and warnings as part of the fact. Never silently remove them.
